title: Common Rail Pressure Sensor High Error
detail_of_failure: A high voltage occurs in the signal circuit of the common rail pressure sensor.
controller_action: Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
machine_effect: • Engine speed or output lowers. • Engine does not start.
related_information: • The signal voltage of the common rail pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 36401) • When the connector of the common rail pressure sensor is disconnected, this failure code is shown. • The connector of “socket” for troubleshooting for this sensor is female only. So the check for open circuit in the wiring harness and voltage check in the sensor connector cannot be done (T-adapter is not provided). • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

steps.cause: Defective common rail pressure sensor power supply system
steps.procedure: If failure code [CA227] or [CA187] is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors CAM SENSOR, FUEL RAIL PRESS, BOOST PRESS & IMT, and ECM. 3. Connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector FUEL RAIL PRESS, and insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Turn the starting switch to ON position (with connector FUEL-RAIL PRESS disconnected). REMARK ECM pin (25) is connected to the 5V through resistor in engine controller.

If no failure is found by the above checks, it is possible that there is an open circuit in the wiring harness. See “Diagnose Open Circuit of Hydraulic Pressure Sensor System Wiring Harness” of “RELATED INFORMATION ON TROUBLESHOOTING”.

steps.cause: Defectiv pressure voltage controlle e common rail sensor (input error in engine r)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found in causes 1 through 5 but found in cause 6, the sensor is defective. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Starting switch: ON
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
